about: A figure around a recharts chart, with a tooltip, a legend that shows and hides series, a caption that states the finding, and an empty state. Each series takes its color from a hue or a palette of the theme.

latency.about: Hourly p95 latency against a 300ms target, which takes the error palette and a dashed line.
latency.caption: Latency passed the 300ms target between 12:00 and 14:00.
latency.name: p95 latency per hour
latency.title: Threshold

payouts.about: Paid and refunded payouts per day in euros. The ticks and the tooltip are written in the locale, and a press in the legend hides or shows a series.
payouts.caption: Refunds rose to €1,250 on Thursday, a fifth of the day's payouts.
payouts.name: Payouts per day
payouts.title: Line

quiet.about: A chart without rows shows its empty state in the plot's place, at the plot's ratio.
quiet.caption: Disputes per day over the last 7 days.
quiet.empty: No disputes in the last 7 days.
quiet.name: Disputes per day
quiet.title: Empty

ratio.about: The plot's aspect ratio from the theme's scale, which gives recharts a height to measure.
ratio.title: Ratios

signups.about: Sign-ups per plan per month as stacked bars, each plan in the hue its series states.
signups.caption: Sign-ups grew every month. The Growth plan took 38% of September's.
signups.name: Sign-ups per plan
signups.title: Stacked bars

storage.about: Storage per kind of file as a donut. Each sector is a series, so the legend shows and hides sectors.
storage.caption: Video takes 60% of the 195.5 GB in use.
storage.name: Storage per kind of file
storage.title: Donut

title: Chart
